title:
This type represents an object that has the ability to interpret itself for machine learning purposes. An
interpretable object will most likely use {@link MlInterpreter}s to perform interpret operations to provide an
understanding of the object's underlying behavior. Please note an {@link MlInterpretable} object is not the same as
an {@link MlInterpreter} object. While {@link MlInterpretable} defines the ability for an object to be interpreted,
an {@link  MlInterpreter} will contain actual interpretation algorithms.
name: MlInterpretable
